title: Trace the production path before crediting a local speedup
applies_when: A helper or kernel microbenchmark improves, but backend dispatch, fallback behavior or its share of the target workload is uncertain.
lesson: Trace representative requests to the implementation that actually runs. Estimate how much elapsed time that component can remove before expanding optimization work. An Amdahl estimate needs a measured non-overlapping time share and unchanged residual work; inclusive profiler totals are not automatically that share. Confirm the eventual result in the target workload.
avoid_when: Do not treat a configuration flag as execution evidence, invent a missing time share, or apply a universal minimum gain. Amdahl's simple serial model needs adjustment when overlap, concurrency or bottlenecks change.

evidence.note: Official guidance supports realistic workload profiling and scope-limited speedup bounds. It does not establish reachability or a measured gain for any particular candidate.
